- SilverColours






**Colours.** The most colourful MacBook line-up ever. Choose from four stunning colours with colour-coordinated keyboards. Shown in Silver.

MacBook Neo Colours.

  - Silver
  - Blush
  - Citrus
  - Indigo

- Durable design






**Durable design.** MacBook Neo is made with a durable recycled aluminium enclosure that helps it reach 60% recycled content by weight, the most ever in any Apple product.[4](https://www.apple.com/in/macbook-neo/#footnote-7)

- Display






**Display.** With outstanding resolution and 500 nits of brightness, the 33.02 cm (13″) Liquid Retina display brings photos, websites and videos to life with refreshing clarity and vivid colours.[2](https://www.apple.com/in/macbook-neo/#footnote-5)

- Keyboard and trackpad






**Keyboard and trackpad.** The Magic Keyboard delivers a precise and comfortable typing experience. And the large Multi-Touch trackpad lets you tap, pinch, swipe and click anywhere.

- Touch ID






**Touch ID.** The model with Touch ID lets you easily unlock your MacBook Neo, sign in to websites and apps, and download apps with the touch of your finger.

- Camera






**Camera.** The 1080p FaceTime HD camera gives you a clear and crisp appearance on video calls.

- Mics and speakers






**Mics and speakers.** Two side-firing speakers deliver immersive sound, and dual microphones isolate and enhance your voice for crystal clarity.

- Connectivity






**Connectivity.** Two USB-C ports and a headphone jack let you connect a variety of accessories, transfer your data and charge MacBook Neo.


### Everyday productivity.

Answering email, taking video calls, browsing the web, updating after⁠-⁠school schedules, sharing photos — master your to⁠-⁠do list with MacBook Neo.

![MacBook Neo, citrus color, user is composing an email invitation to an art exhibit, website for the event open alongside](https://www.apple.com/v/macbook-neo/b/images/overview/product-stories/performance/performance_hero_1_static__c782t9ycacya_large.jpg)

### Conquer your courses.

MacBook Neo is perfect for learning, whether you’re cramming for finals, using Apple Intelligence to summarise class notes[3](https://www.apple.com/in/macbook-neo/#footnote-6) or creating presentations.

![MacBook Neo, blush color, screen shows an article on biomimicry and a quiz on similar subject matter](https://www.apple.com/v/macbook-neo/b/images/overview/product-stories/performance/performance_hero_2_static__eyt6d992mbau_large.jpg)

### Make work feel like play.

From building spreadsheets to managing payroll, MacBook Neo gets the job done.

![MacBook Neo, indigo color, video call in progress, Freeform window with a menu, food photography, and illustrations for a dim sum restaurant](https://www.apple.com/in/macbook-neo/images/overview/product-stories/performance/performance_hero_3_static__dzg6zb7h18a6_large.jpg)

### Amusement perks.

With impressive graphics and a vibrant Liquid Retina display, your movies, shows, videos and games are incredibly detailed.

![MacBook Neo, silver color, screen shows a scene from the game Oceanhorn 3](https://www.apple.com/v/macbook-neo/b/images/overview/product-stories/performance/performance_hero_4_static__dkvbsb4wapw2_large.jpg)

### Fly through everyday tasks.

The A18 Pro chip breezes through your go‑to apps and AI activities, putting power and efficiency at your fingertips.

![A young person in their bedroom wearing headphones uses MacBook Neo, blush color, to book a nail appointment](https://www.apple.com/v/macbook-neo/b/images/overview/product-stories/performance/performance_lifestyle__erk9efbsqgqe_large.jpg)

### Your constant companion.

MacBook Neo is ready to go where you go, from early-morning classes to late-night browsing.

Up to16 hrbattery life on a single charge[1](https://www.apple.com/in/macbook-neo/#footnote-4)

33.02 cm (13″) Liquid Retina display with support for 1 billion colours.[2](https://www.apple.com/in/macbook-neo/#footnote-5)

3.6 millionpixels for incredible resolution

500nits of brightness

Stream _Pluribus_ on Apple TV with a subscription.

![MacBook Neo, citrus color, scene from Pluribus show onscreen](https://www.apple.com/v/macbook-neo/b/images/overview/product-stories/display-camera-audio/dca_display__dxwm2scb6qs2_large.png)

The 1080p FaceTime HD camera delivers vibrant video so you always look your best.

![MacBook Neo, citrus color, camera located above display, FaceTime video call onscreen](https://www.apple.com/v/macbook-neo/b/images/overview/product-stories/display-camera-audio/dca_camera__bmfj0hk3imnm_large.png)

A dual-mic array with beamforming technology isolates and enhances your voice while minimising background noise. Your voice sounds focused and clear.

Dual side-firing speakers deliver immersive sound. And Spatial Audio with support for Dolby Atmos creates a 3D listening experience for music, shows and movies.

![MacBook Neo, citrus color, open, sound waves rippling from speaker on right side of computer toward front](https://www.apple.com/v/macbook-neo/b/images/overview/product-stories/display-camera-audio/dca_audio__c8gle92xcmie_xlarge.jpg)

![MacBook Neo, blush color, using ChatGPT to generate image of grapefruit, other windows contain a Keynote document titled molecule posters with images of fruits and vegetables and associated molecular compounds, and a related Microsoft Word document](https://www.apple.com/v/macbook-neo/b/images/overview/product-stories/apple-intelligence/ai_apps__duxcxyziriie_large.jpg)

### Built for Apple Intelligence.

Apple Intelligence is the personal intelligence system that helps you write, express yourself and get things done.[3](https://www.apple.com/in/macbook-neo/#footnote-6) And it comes fully integrated into MacBook Neo.

- ### Writing Tools.



Proofread your text and rewrite different versions until the tone and wording are just right, and summarise selected text with a click.





![Writing Tools in use, highlighting large paragraph of text in an email, Writing Tools menu shows Key Points option selected, with icon of bulleted list](https://www.apple.com/v/macbook-neo/b/images/overview/product-stories/apple-intelligence/ai_writing_tools__bfvoccis7gpe_large.jpg)

- ### Genmoji.



Express yourself with delightful, custom-made emoji. Type a description or mix your favourite emoji to create something entirely new.





![Genmoji feature in use, emoji of a sloth holding a light bulb, surrounded by a smaller sloth emoji and light bulb emoji](https://www.apple.com/v/macbook-neo/b/images/overview/product-stories/apple-intelligence/ai_genmoji__bheiwkil5yvm_large.jpg)

- ### Clean Up.



Perfect your photos by quickly removing distractions and unwanted background objects with a simple highlight and click.[5](https://www.apple.com/in/macbook-neo/#footnote-8)





![Clean Up tool in use, highlighting a traffic cone to be removed from a photo](https://www.apple.com/v/macbook-neo/b/images/overview/product-stories/apple-intelligence/ai_cleanup__f6om417e1q6i_large.jpg)


![](https://www.apple.com/v/macbook-neo/b/images/overview/product-stories/apple-intelligence/ai_lock__wfc9sus90hu2_large.png)

### Great powers come with great privacy.

Apple Intelligence is designed to protect your privacy at every step. It’s integrated into the core of your Mac through on-device processing. So it’s aware of your personal information without collecting your personal information. And with groundbreaking Private Cloud Compute, Apple Intelligence can draw on larger server-based models, running on Apple silicon, to handle more complex requests for you while protecting your privacy.

![](https://www.apple.com/v/macbook-neo/b/images/overview/product-stories/macos/hero/macos_hero__exzf2qzsprcm_xlarge.jpg)

## macOS

### Smooth operator.

macOS is the powerful yet friendly operating system that makes a Mac a Mac. And if you already have an iPhone, everything will feel familiar. Simple navigation. Free, automatic updates. Apps that run without a hitch. All wrapped up in a design with Liquid Glass, bringing clarity to everything you do.

- ### Easy. Does it all.



macOS feels simple and intuitive — quickly access your apps and files, neatly tile multiple windows and efficiently navigate with the Multi-Touch trackpad.







![](https://www.apple.com/v/macbook-neo/b/images/overview/product-stories/macos/caption-gallery/macos_multitasking_endframe__uj1jqlh9scye_large.jpg)![](https://www.apple.com/v/macbook-neo/b/images/overview/product-stories/macos/caption-gallery/macos_multitasking_startframe__dmi9oslhuc2u_large.jpg)

![MacBook Neo, indigo color, screen shows composing a welcome email to new employee of bookstore, other tiled windows contain Notes doc about onboarding and bookstore's employee portal website in Safari](https://www.apple.com/v/macbook-neo/b/images/overview/product-stories/macos/caption-gallery/macos_multitasking_endframe__uj1jqlh9scye_large.jpg)

- ### Built-in Apple apps.



Browse the web with Safari. Create gorgeous presentations in Keynote. Call friends on FaceTime.[6](https://www.apple.com/in/macbook-neo/#footnote-9) MacBook Neo comes loaded with apps ready for your everyday work and play.





![Apple apps: Keynote, Pages, Numbers, Music, Photos, Notes, Calendar, Mail, FaceTime, Messages, App Store](https://www.apple.com/v/macbook-neo/b/images/overview/product-stories/macos/caption-gallery/macos_apps__edy29g0syaie_large.jpg)

- ### Use your go-to apps.



From Microsoft 365 Copilot to Zoom, the apps you know and love run wonderfully on Mac. Just download your favourites from the App Store — and discover thousands more along the way.





![Applications window containing various apps](https://www.apple.com/v/macbook-neo/b/images/overview/product-stories/macos/caption-gallery/macos_favorite__bne7pmly06eu_large.jpg)

- ### Make it yours.



Personalise your MacBook Neo with light or dark mode, add colour-tinted icons, or enlarge or shrink your Dock and toolbars to a size that’s just right for you.





![MacBook Neo screen customized with desktop background of a seaside rooftop patio and various widgets like Music, Calendar, Weather, and Reminders](https://www.apple.com/v/macbook-neo/b/images/overview/product-stories/macos/caption-gallery/macos_customize__f6yv65kj85iu_large.jpg)

- ### Act fast with Spotlight.



Quickly find things on your MacBook Neo and see suggestions from apps, files, actions, the internet and your Clipboard.





![Spotlight in use, the search query, renovation inspo, has returned various renovation-related folders and documents](https://www.apple.com/v/macbook-neo/b/images/overview/product-stories/macos/caption-gallery/macos_spotlight__dvyi22ugugwi_large.jpg)


![](https://www.apple.com/v/macbook-neo/b/images/overview/product-stories/continuity/continuity_hero_mbn_screen_01__fq2x6kk9fwii_large.jpg)

![](https://www.apple.com/v/macbook-neo/b/images/overview/product-stories/continuity/continuity_hero_mbn_screen_02__ezfwq6yahyye_large.jpg)![](https://www.apple.com/v/macbook-neo/b/images/overview/product-stories/continuity/continuity_hero_mbn_screen_03__czywdzzlpno2_large.jpg)

![](https://www.apple.com/v/macbook-neo/b/images/overview/product-stories/continuity/continuity_hero_iphone_screen_endframe__d526dazbheky_large.jpg)

- Calls and Texts

- Handoff

- iPhone Mirroring

- AirDrop

- Instant Hotspot

- Universal Clipboard


![Showing Phone app on MacBook Neo with various contacts and a list of recent calls, one highlighted call shows information on the associated contact](https://www.apple.com/v/macbook-neo/b/images/overview/product-stories/continuity/continuity_calls_texts__b0do2lwtd04i_large.jpg)

### Call and text from your Mac.

Make or take calls directly from your MacBook Neo just like you do on your iPhone. And the texts on your iPhone also appear on your Mac, so you can continue conversations across devices.[7](https://www.apple.com/in/macbook-neo/#footnote-10)

![MacBook Neo, indigo color, next to iPhone, both screens show the same email, announcing an event at a community center](https://www.apple.com/v/macbook-neo/b/images/overview/product-stories/continuity/continuity_handoff__cf6kiu4th95y_large.jpg)

### Start here. Finish there.

With Handoff, when your devices are near each other, you can seamlessly pass your works-in-progress from one device to the other — like starting an email or editing a note on your MacBook Neo and finishing it on your iPhone.[8](https://www.apple.com/in/macbook-neo/#footnote-11)

![iPhone screen displayed within MacBook Neo screen, showing Uber Eats app](https://www.apple.com/in/macbook-neo/images/overview/product-stories/continuity/continuity_iphone_mirroring__b50ykb21i7aq_large.jpg)

### Use your iPhone from your Mac.

iPhone Mirroring lets you see and use the screen of your iPhone on your MacBook Neo display.[9](https://www.apple.com/in/macbook-neo/#footnote-12) And when you’re playing music, running a timer or tracking a delivery, you can view and control these Live Activities on your iPhone and your Mac.

![MacBook Neo, silver color, showing iMovie window titled Elder Wisdom Project, next to iPhone showing video of one of the people pictured in iMovie window, below video is a list of sharing options, including AirDrop](https://www.apple.com/v/macbook-neo/b/images/overview/product-stories/continuity/continuity_airdrop__dtzrxj9fh6uu_large.jpg)

### Share by air.

With AirDrop, you can quickly share large files between your MacBook Neo and iPhone. You can also choose to share with others around you who have a Mac, iPhone or iPad. It’s never been easier to send and receive photos, documents and more — even without a Wi-Fi network.

![MacBook Neo, blush color, Wi-Fi menu shows Personal Hotspot section with ”Marlena's iPhone” as an option to select](https://www.apple.com/v/macbook-neo/b/images/overview/product-stories/continuity/continuity_hotspot__bhpq9e0b9ho2_large.jpg)

### No Wi-Fi? No problem.

With Instant Hotspot, you can share the cellular connection on your iPhone with your nearby MacBook Neo. So you can get online even when you don’t have a Wi-Fi signal.

![MacBook Neo, indigo color, Keynote document onscreen with pitch deck for a product line, next to iPhone showing text selected in Notes app](https://www.apple.com/v/macbook-neo/b/images/overview/product-stories/continuity/continuity_universal_clipboard__cj22n8iioi4i_large.jpg)

### Copy and paste across devices.

Use Universal Clipboard to copy images, video or text from an app on your iPhone. Then paste into another app on your nearby Mac — or vice versa.

![MacBook Neo, citrus color, a person's hand on trackpad, multiple windows open including Music, Calendar, and Microsoft PowerPoint apps](https://www.apple.com/v/macbook-neo/b/images/overview/product-stories/new-to-mac/ntm_hero_endframe__4u6qzi7yehe6_large.jpg)![](https://www.apple.com/v/macbook-neo/b/images/overview/product-stories/new-to-mac/ntm_hero_startframe__exo0j784536u_large.jpg)

![MacBook Neo, citrus color, a person's hand on trackpad, multiple windows open including Music, Calendar, and Microsoft PowerPoint apps](https://www.apple.com/v/macbook-neo/b/images/overview/product-stories/new-to-mac/ntm_hero_endframe__4u6qzi7yehe6_large.jpg)

- ### Setup in a snap.



Use your iPhone to import files, apps and more from iCloud with Setup Assistant. Switching from a PC? Migration Assistant makes setup quick and straightforward. If you need more help, Apple Support is always just an online chat, phone call or in‑store appointment away.





![Illustration of two laptops connected by line, second shows green checkmark onscreen indicating migration process is complete](https://www.apple.com/v/macbook-neo/b/images/overview/product-stories/new-to-mac/ntm_migration__gkxw0dthote2_large.jpg)

- ### Access files anywhere.



iCloud privately stores your photos, contacts and documents in one place so you can access them on all your Apple devices — and easily share files between devices.





![Emoji of smiling face surrounded by various app icons: Music, iCloud Drive, Notes, Mail, Contacts, Calendar, Messages, and Photos](https://www.apple.com/v/macbook-neo/b/images/overview/product-stories/new-to-mac/ntm_icloud__d02y9599nsa6_large.jpg)

- ### Remarkably reliable.



Free, regular software updates help avoid crashes and keep your Mac running smoothly and securely for years to come. These updates also deliver new features that can make an already incredible Mac even better.





![Apple Security](https://www.apple.com/v/macbook-neo/b/images/overview/product-stories/new-to-mac/ntm_security__ftcixp8e4xu2_large.jpg)

- ### Tips on tap.



Use the built-in Tips app to get the most out of your Mac. Discover tricks, search for specific topics, browse user guides and collections, and stay up to date with the latest suggestions.





![Tips app icon](https://www.apple.com/v/macbook-neo/b/images/overview/product-stories/new-to-mac/ntm_tips__fqfxfa3hc5qy_large.jpg)

- ### Never used a Mac? No problem.



Mac is easy to learn and easy to use. And if you’re considering making the switch from PC to Mac, getting started is a breeze.





![Yep, Mac does that](https://www.apple.com/v/macbook-neo/b/images/overview/product-stories/new-to-mac/ntm_mdt__czfow7s9tru6_large.jpg)



[Learn more](https://www.apple.com/in/macbook-neo/mac-does-that/)


![MacBook Neo, indigo colour, Safari prompting user to log in using Touch ID or password to website titled Community Care Clinic](https://www.apple.com/v/macbook-neo/b/images/overview/product-stories/security/security_hero__d6lkldnuw0ae_large.jpg)

- ### Lock Key or Touch ID.



The Lock Key wakes and locks your screen and powers your Mac on and off. For even more ease, MacBook Neo with Touch ID uses your fingerprint to unlock your Mac and sign in to apps and sites.





![MacBook Neo, silver color, person's finger on Touch ID sensor in top-right corner of keyboard](https://www.apple.com/v/macbook-neo/b/images/overview/product-stories/security/security_touchid__e9ohsg1cylqq_large.jpg)

- ### Protected if lost.



The Find My app helps you quickly pinpoint where your MacBook Neo is and lock or erase it from afar. And FileVault automatically encrypts your data so it’s completely unreadable — your data will remain secure if your Mac is ever lost or stolen.

## Recycled Material

Our approach.

Using recycled materials, like 90% recycled aluminium in MacBook Neo, reduces the need to mine new material, which avoids the carbon emissions and environmental impacts of mining.
[Learn more in our Product Environmental Report (PDF), opens in a new tab](https://www.apple.com/in/environment/pdf/products/notebooks/MacBook_Neo_PER_Mar2026.pdf)

How you can help.

You can protect the earth’s precious resources by trading in, passing down or recycling devices and accessories you no longer use. You can bring them into any Apple Store for free, secure recycling. We also offer other ways to recycle, including mail‑in options.
[Learn how to trade in or recycle devices](https://www.apple.com/in/shop/goto/trade_in/#recycle)

## Renewable Electricity

Our approach.

Using electricity from renewable sources like wind and solar across our global supply chain — instead of fossil fuels — significantly reduces carbon emissions from manufacturing Apple products.
[Learn more in our Product Environmental Report (PDF), opens in a new tab](https://www.apple.com/in/environment/pdf/products/notebooks/MacBook_Neo_PER_Mar2026.pdf)

How you can help.

You can extend the lifespan of your batteries and Apple products by using Optimised Battery Charging. It works by learning your charging habits and delaying the final charge — from 80% to 100% — until you are likely to need it.
[Learn more about Optimised Battery Charging](https://support.apple.com/en-in/102338)

## Package and Ship

Our approach.

MacBook Neo comes in a 100% fibre-based box as part of our commitment to remove plastic from the packaging of all Apple products.
[Learn more in our Product Environmental Report (PDF), opens in a new tab](https://www.apple.com/in/environment/pdf/products/notebooks/MacBook_Neo_PER_Mar2026.pdf)

How you can help.

New Apple products come in paper packaging that’s 100% fibre-based. In most places, you can put the entire box into your household recycling bin. You can also bring Apple packaging to any Apple Store and we’ll recycle it for free.
[Learn more about recycling](https://www.apple.com/in/shop/goto/trade_in/#recycle)
